title: Hosted API: minimal quickstart screenshot tiles and compact code composer
creator: Amara Chen
description: Produce a compact set of onboarding visuals for the Hosted API quickstart that focuses on minimal cognitive load and cross-device consistency. Deliver high-fidelity screenshot tiles for: (1) model selection compact panel, (2) collapsed + expanded request builder states (prompt + params toggle), (3) three compact code snippets (curl, Python, Node) with copy-to-clipboard affordance highlighted, and (4) streaming response preview with a live example line. Include retina (2x) exports, one mobile narrow breakpoint (360px), and one tablet breakpoint (768px). Provide accessible alt text for all images and a short caption strip for docs usage. Coordinate with ENG for any UI feature differences (function calling UI, streaming toggle, token controls).
acceptance_criteria: Three responsive sets of screenshots (desktop default, tablet 768px, mobile 360px) exported at 1x and 2x
Model select tile shows inline search, recent models, and a selected model chip with cost/time microcopy
Request builder tiles show collapsed state (prompt + quick presets) and expanded advanced options with streaming toggle visible
Code snippet tile includes curl, Python (requests/async example), and Node (fetch) snippets with highlighted copy button and shortened token estimate callout
All assets have accessible alt text and a single-line caption stored with the file metadata
Filenames follow org convention: hosted_quick_<component>_<bp>[_v#]@2x.png where bp = desktop|tablet|mobile
Design sign-off (Design Lead) and engineering verification (ENG) that UI matches what will ship
comments: 2026-03-01 Amara Chen: Created ticket. Initial scope in description. Tagged ENG for verification of streaming UI and function-calling control names.

screenshot_requests: Model selector (desktop): show search open, recent models list, selected model chip, cost/time microcopy (0.4ms/1.2¢) and 'Use' CTA highlighted
Request builder collapsed (desktop): prompt area with example prompt, presets bar (Q/A, summarization, rewrite), small 'Advanced' chevron
Request builder expanded (desktop): show params panel with Max tokens, Temperature (0.0-1.0 slider), Streaming toggle on, function-calling collapsed, 'Run' primary CTA
Streaming preview (desktop): show partial output appearing line-by-line, 'Stop' inline button visible and streaming indicator pulsing
Code tile (desktop): three tabs/columns: curl, Python (requests + async snippet comment), Node (fetch) with highlighted copy button and one-line token estimate above snippets
Mobile narrow variants for model select and request builder with stacked elements and truncated microcopy
Tablet variants showing two-column layout for code + preview
ux_notes: Prefer microcopy: use sentence-case labels (e.g., 'Max tokens', 'Temperature') to reduce visual weight
Token estimate shown as monospace, 10px caption under code tile; color token = muted-600 per design system
Copy button should show 'Copied' toast for 1.5s on success; include small checkmark badge on screenshot where appropriate
Alt text guidelines: 10-20 words describing visible UI state, avoid product names in alt when used as decorative graphic
Ensure focus ring visible for keyboard focus (2px outline using focus-500 token) in exported states where interactive elements are shown
